stories.title: Former Colorado National Guard captain's lawsuit over protest heads toward trial
stories.summary: Former Colorado National Guard Captain Alan Kennedy is suing over punishment he received for participating in a protest over George Floyd's murder.

stories.title: Inscribed knife found near where skeletal remains were discovered at Colorado state park
stories.summary: Authorities are asking for help identifying a knife found with a pair of pants near where skeletal remains were discovered at Chatfield State Park.

stories.title: 7-story tall Christmas tree is back in Denver this holiday season
stories.summary: The Mile High Tree, a towering digital Christmas tree, returns to Denver's Auraria Campus, offering immersive light shows synced to holiday music.

stories.title: Why driving over Vail Pass should be a little easier this winter
stories.summary: The 10-mile stretch of I-70 on Vail Pass has been known as one of Colorado’s most dangerous stretches of road, but a $300M project should improve safety.

stories.title: Denver enters top 5 for latest first snow, Dense Fog Advisory in northern Colorado
stories.summary: Denver enters the top five for latest first snows as a storm system brings mountain snow to Colorado. Winds are expected to pick up Tuesday night.

stories.title: High winds and light snow forecast for Colorado mountains as Pacific storm approaches
stories.summary: Areas of patchy fog expected again early this morning over northern Colorado. Mild and dry today. Next storm set to bring high winds and light mountain snow.

stories.title: Here's the holiday season TV schedule on NBC
stories.summary: NBC unveils its holiday 2026 schedule, featuring the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade and new specials like “Christmas With Snoop Dogg.”

stories.title: Man arrested in connection with fatal stabbing of his mother in Denver
stories.summary: The stabbing happened in the 4300 block of Shoshone Street on either Nov. 13 or 14, according to police.

stories.title: Arvada celebrates 100 years since first sale of Arva-Pride flour through community quilt project
stories.summary: Each quilt includes printed fabrics from original Arva-Pride flour sacks.

stories.title: DPS board votes on 3 finalists for open seat, following resignation DJ Torres
stories.summary: The DPS board selected three finalists from 12 applicants for a vacant board seat. It comes after months of dysfunction and infighting amongst board members.

stories.title: Colorado native named a 2027 Rhodes scholar
stories.summary: Elizabeth Koenck, of Aurora, Colorado, is among the 32 Americans named as 2027 Rhodes scholars.

stories.title: Lakewood restaurant becomes drop-off point for Coats for Colfax winter gear drive
stories.summary: A grassroots effort by Coats for Colfax, led by community members, gathers winter gear for those living on the streets, highlighting growing support and urgent need.
